It goes by way of Al Zubarah Archaeological Site, Madinat Hamad 3 Burial Mound Field, Madinat Hamad 2 Burial Mound Field and back through Madinat Hamad 3 Burial Mound Field. It crosses from Qatar into Bahrain - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
